terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: These terms govern the use of petsFollow Pro by veterinarians and the mobile app by pet owners. The app enables prescribed follow-up (messaging, Care/Horse reminders, respiratory rate readings) and communication with the practice. Subscription and addon payments are processed by Stripe. Contact: barbara{'@'}petsfollow.app · 0478.02.33.77.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: petsFollow processes personal data to provide animal care continuity: identity (name, email), pet data (name, species, breed, photos), respiratory rate readings (animal health data), messages and media with the practice, visit reports (text and audio recordings), GPS coordinates of home visits (care professionals), notification tokens (Firebase Cloud Messaging), payment data processed by Stripe. Purposes: account, monitoring, messaging, notifications, visit reports, billing. AI processing: Google Gemini is used to improve visit reports, import client files and power the sales pitch training (audio processed in real time, not retained by Google). Partners: Google (Sign-In, FCM, Gemini), Stripe, Google Cloud Platform hosting. Retention: account lifetime then erasure; inactive accounts purged after 3 years; visit report audio kept as long as the record. GDPR rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability): settings (export your data, delete account), or barbara{'@'}petsfollow.app.

aiPlaybook.subtitle: Mode d’emploi + argumentaire — imprimable / envoyable
aiPlaybook.mailBody:
Hello,

Here is the petsFollow AI visit-report guide — included in the Pro offer (no add-on).
aiPlaybook.badge: Included in Pro · ROI proof from day 60
aiPlaybook.promise: Dictate, structure, save time on every visit — AI is included in your Pro subscription.
aiPlaybook.whoBody: Cabinets VetPro (Web + Pro Light). Les care_pro rattachés à un animal du cabinet activé en bénéficient aussi sur ces visites.
aiPlaybook.change1: Avant : CR tapés le soir, dossiers incomplets, fatigue terrain.
aiPlaybook.change2: Après : dictée mobile → transcription → CR structuré (anamnèse, examen, diagnostic proposé, plan).
aiPlaybook.change3: At day 60: time-saved summary on the dashboard — clear value proof.
aiPlaybook.step1: AI visit reports are included with Pro — sales can enable ROI tracking from petsFollow.
aiPlaybook.step2: Sur place : obtenir l’accord oral du client (case à cocher) avant d’enregistrer.
aiPlaybook.step3: Dicter le CR dans Pro Light (Flutter) ou uploader un fichier audio sur le calendrier Web.
aiPlaybook.step4: Lancer « Améliorer » pour structurer le texte, puis éditer si besoin.
aiPlaybook.step5: Finaliser = validation exclusive du pro (purge audio).
aiPlaybook.step6: À partir de J60, lire le ROI (minutes gagnées) sur le tableau de bord VetPro.
aiPlaybook.pitchBody: “In Pro, AI is included. You dictate in the field, AI structures the record. At day 60 we review time saved together — proof that SaaS works for you.”
aiPlaybook.obj1a: Anchor on time: 5–7 min/report × 10 reports/day ≈ 1 h/day. AI is already in the Pro ticket — not a second subscription.
aiPlaybook.obj2a: Ici : consentement, CR structuré métier, dossier animal, ROI cabinet, pas un fichier texte isolé.
aiPlaybook.obj3a: Oui si droits write notes. VetLight / care_pro : seulement si le cabinet de la visite est activé.
aiPlaybook.roiBody: Formula: AI-assisted reports × (baseline 10 min − 4 min AI). Shown from day 60. AI is included in Pro — proof drives adoption, not add-on conversion.
aiPlaybook.calJ90: Day 90 — adoption review; manual reports always possible
aiPlaybook.frictionBody: 0 usage à J7, chute d’usage, erreurs Gemini, NPS ≤ 6, abandon après démarrage. L’app vous alerte ; utilisez ce guide pour la relance.

asvMemo.title: ASV memo
asvMemo.subtitle: 10-minute leave-behind for reception — printable / PDF
asvMemo.mailBodyPdf:
Hello,

Please find the petsFollow memo sheet for veterinary assistants / reception (print or save as PDF from the commercial space).

Goal: 10 minutes to see what changes at the front desk.

Best regards,
asvMemo.ctaHint: Leave-behind for the ASV — 10 min, printable as PDF.
asvMemo.docTitle: petsFollow for veterinary assistants — what changes in your day
asvMemo.promise: Ten minutes to see how petsFollow eases the front desk: fewer scattered calls, fewer manual follow-ups, a clear clients / calendar / messages cockpit — without touching the medical record.
asvMemo.pain1: Personal SMS, scattered emails and unlogged walk-in calls overload reception.
asvMemo.pain2: Out-of-hours questions keep coming when the practice is closed.
asvMemo.pain3: Appointment reminders and vaccine / treatment recalls still go through the phone.
asvMemo.pain4: On the shared front-desk PC, switching profiles is slow and weakly secured.
asvMemo.gain1: Messaging sorted by animal / file: photos and questions in the right thread — not on the front-desk phone.
asvMemo.gain2: Unavailable / closed mode: owners see the practice is not responding — fewer off-hours solicitations.
asvMemo.gain3: Appointment request from the client app → you confirm; the owner is notified (push + email).
asvMemo.gain4: Pre-consultation: reason and urgency already in the file before arrival — fewer phone intakes.
asvMemo.gain5: Care reminders on the owner side (vaccines, treatments): fewer “please call for the booster” calls.
asvMemo.gain6: Front-desk switch: ASV ↔ vet profile in seconds, each recovers their last screen.
asvMemo.notBody: The secretary / ASV role covers clients, calendar and messaging — not clinical writing. petsFollow does not turn you into a “second vet”: it organises client relations while the veterinarian keeps the medical side.
asvMemo.demoTitle: Flash demo in 3 steps (at the front desk)
asvMemo.demo1: Messaging: open an animal thread, show sorted photos / questions.
asvMemo.demo2: Calendar: a client appointment request to confirm, then owner notification.
asvMemo.demo3: Desk switch: change profile on the same shared PC.
asvMemo.obj1q: “Is this extra work for the ASV?”
asvMemo.obj1a: On the contrary: it reduces calls and scattered messages by putting them on one screen.
asvMemo.obj2a: No. Emergencies stay on the phone. petsFollow takes everyday questions, confirmations and reminders off the front desk.
asvMemo.obj3a: Those who are already ease the desk; others keep the phone. You gain on digital volume without losing the rest.
asvMemo.obj4a: Role-based rights: reception has what it needs to welcome and schedule, without clinical notes.
asvMemo.takeawayBody: “petsFollow does not replace the emergency phone: it takes questions, confirmations and reminders that clog the front desk off the ASV, while the owner follows care and appointments in the app.”
asvMemo.footer: Ask for a 10-minute demo at the front desk. petsFollow — prescribed care continuity · digital passport.
